title: Fed fails to scare Dalal Street: Sensex jumps 990 points as Maruti leads a 4.4% auto rally
short: Sensex +990, Nifty 25,514 as autos jump 4.4%; IT slips
dek: The Nifty rose 1.14% to 25,514.30 and the Sensex 989.94 points to 83,021.75, recovering all of Wednesday's fall and more. Maruti Suzuki jumped 7.58%, while IT stocks fell after hawkish Fed minutes. The rupee rose 5 paise to 93.36.
